summary: Growth Engine iteration 1: 18/18 backend tests pass (demand/most-wanted, demand/by-city, demand/by-artist, leads/capture, leads/count, metrics/vitals, security headers). All 4 new frontend pages render correctly with proper hero, lists, FAQs, related links. Coming Soon page (justin-bieber-amsterdam) UI is correct and lead capture E2E works (success state shown). HOWEVER: 2 critical SEO regressions on Coming Soon page — meta robots tag leaks 'index, follow' (should be 'noindex, follow') and AggregateOffer JSON-LD schema is present (spec: no schema).

integration_issues.flow: Justin Bieber Coming Soon page meta robots
integration_issues.issue: Rendered HTML has <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large..."> instead of required 'noindex, follow'. Root cause: /app/frontend/public/index.html line 64 sets default index,follow, and React 19 native <meta> from ComingSoonEvent.jsx line 102 is NOT replacing it (likely hoisting dedup issue). The x-robots-tag HTTP header is correctly set to 'noindex, nofollow' by server middleware, so Google will obey that, but meta tag inconsistency is a SEO smell and violates spec.

integration_issues.flow: Justin Bieber Coming Soon page schema
integration_issues.issue: HTML contains JSON-LD AggregateOffer schema (lowPrice/highPrice/offerCount/availability:InStock) injected by /app/frontend/public/index.html line 622 (inline 'ph-event' builder). Spec explicitly forbids AggregateOffer on unverified demand pages. The injector needs to check UNVERIFIED_DEMAND_PAGES list or be removed for those paths.

issues: No data-testid on venue-guide section (only H2 text). Add data-testid="venue-guide" for testability.

action_items: FIX: Remove default <meta name="robots" content="index, follow ..."> from /app/frontend/public/index.html (line 64) OR ensure React 19 native metadata in ComingSoonEvent.jsx wins. Preferred: remove from index.html and let each page/component declare its own robots meta.

FIX: Gate the 'ph-event' AggregateOffer JSON-LD injector in /app/frontend/public/index.html (~line 622) so it skips any path in UNVERIFIED_DEMAND_PAGES (currently: 'justin-bieber-amsterdam-2026-tickets'). Alternative: move schema generation fully into React components and drop the inline pre-hydration script for these paths.
MINOR: Add data-testid="venue-guide" to venue section heading/container in /app/frontend/src/components/CityDemandPage.jsx for easier testing.

critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate meta tag injection: index.html has inline JS (lines 95, 450) AND React 19 components declare <meta>. These compete and cause the robots regression. Pick ONE source of truth.

demand/by-city route: city input is lowercased before regex but validator SAFE_STR uses IGNORECASE — good. But 'demand_count' returns len(demand) from event_demand collection, while 'total_leads_tracked' in most-wanted sums lead_count — inconsistent metric semantics. Document the difference.

leads/capture: $inc lead_count on every call including duplicate email+slug. If upsert is truly idempotent per (email,slug), lead_count should only increment on insert (use $inc inside $setOnInsert branch via 2-step: check upsert result and conditionally increment). Current behavior inflates demand metric on re-submission.
/api/demand/* endpoints lack rate limiting and are public — could be scraped for market intelligence. Consider light rate-limit or caching.

robots_meta_regression.observed: <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1" />
robots_meta_regression.root_cause: index.html ships a default 'index, follow' meta and runtime JS (lines 95, 450) further manages robots based on legacy URL patterns. React 19's native <meta> hoist in ComingSoonEvent.jsx does NOT replace the existing tag because attributes differ (React adds its own but doesn't remove the static one). HTTP response header x-robots-tag is correct (noindex, nofollow) via server middleware, so Google will obey that — but the meta tag is a spec violation and inconsistent signal.
robots_meta_regression.mitigation: Option A: Remove default robots meta from index.html. Option B: Make index.html's inline JS explicitly check UNVERIFIED_DEMAND_PAGES paths and set noindex,follow early. Option C: Use react-helmet-async alternative compatible with React 19 (e.g., @unhead/react) for reliable dedup.

aggregate_offer_schema_regression.root_cause: /app/frontend/public/index.html line 622 inline script builds a 'ph-event' (phantom event) JSON-LD with AggregateOffer {lowPrice, highPrice, offerCount:500, availability:InStock} based on URL pattern matching. This fires for ALL speculative event-looking paths, including justin-bieber-amsterdam-2026-tickets. Violates the 'no prices, no Offer schema on Coming Soon' rule.
aggregate_offer_schema_regression.mitigation: Gate 'ph-event' injector with a hardcoded skip-list matching backend UNVERIFIED_DEMAND_PAGES, OR detect coming-soon slug pattern and skip, OR remove inline injector entirely and let React components own schema.
